purpose: Prevent data-mined promotion of bank-specific reaction-function logic.
required_comparisons: Frozen direct Macro baseline on identical eligible events
Reaction-aware interpretation state without rates gating
Reaction-aware interpretation plus separately observed front-end repricing state
Divergence subset reported separately rather than discarded

fixed_evaluation.walkforward: first 40 percent descriptive history, then three chronological OOS folds where sample permits
fixed_evaluation.benchmark: equal-weight G8 basket unless a pre-existing canonical benchmark applies
fixed_evaluation.entry_timing: strictly after all information used by the tested state is observable

promotion_requirements: No threshold tuning using the evaluation sample
No post-hoc weight changes from subblock results
No bank-specific rule promoted solely from full-sample statistics
OOS result must improve interpretability and not materially degrade robustness versus frozen baseline
Statistical uncertainty must be reported even if point estimates improve
Failed bank-specific rules remain documented and are not replaced by another window until a new predeclared hypothesis exists

known_bank_status.FED: comparison withheld until USD Labour PIT exists

promotion_target: separate vNext branch/model version only; never silently mutate frozen v9.3
